metrics.tagger_notes: live check: made-up measurements, no audio behind them

quality.instructions: Rate this separated vocals stem from the measurements in the state. 0 unusable: silent, or mostly something else. 1 poor: heavy bleed or clearly damaged. 2 acceptable: usable, with minor bleed or artifacts. 3 good: clean, small flaws only. 4 excellent: nothing wrong that the measurements show.

acceptable.instructions: Is this vocals stem acceptable to deliver to the user as it is?

criteria.true: It contains its own instrument and little else.
criteria.false: It is silent, mostly another source, or heavily contaminated.

retry_action.instructions: If the stem were not delivered as it is, what should be tried next?

criteria.retry_fallback_model: Separate it again with a different model
criteria.retry_other_ensemble: Separate it again with a blend of several models
criteria.flag_for_human_review: Nothing automatic is likely to help
